scenes.problem: How many halves are in 3 wholes?
rows: Ask how many groups of size 1/2 fit in 3; draw the original amount and the group size.
Partition both amounts into 2ths: 3 is 6/2 and 1/2 is 1/2.
Count groups: (6/2) ÷ (1/2) = 6/1 = 6. A remainder can be part of a group.
scenes.misconception: Divide equal-sized parts; a partial group is a fraction, not an ignored remainder. Zero cannot be a divisor.
